Safe driving: - Adjust driving to visibility, weather, road and traffic conditions.
- Respect traffic regulations and speed limits.
- Ensure passengers wear seat belts and sit correctly.
- Maintain a safe distance from vehicles in front.
Correct sitting position of vehicle occu: - Sit upright with full back against the seat backrest.
- Adjust seat so that pedals can be fully depressed with knees slightly bent.
- Maintain at least 25 cm distance between chest and steering wheel.
- Adjust headrest to the top of the head.
- Ensure front passenger seat is as far back as possible for airbag deployment.
Seat belts: - Seat belts reduce risk of serious injury in accidents.
- Always fasten seat belts before driving.
- Seat belt must lie flat across chest and pelvis; never on neck or stomach.
- Avoid wearing seat belts over hard or fragile objects.
- Periodically check belt condition and function.
PreCrash system: - Prepares the vehicle for a possible accident.
- Functions are cancelled when the critical situation ends.
Airbag system: - Includes front, side and curtain airbags.
- Front airbags provide head and chest protection.
- Side airbags protect the thorax and pelvis in side collisions.
- Curtain airbags cover side windows in severe impacts.
- Airbag system is monitored electronically and warning light signals issues.
Transporting children safely: - Always use appropriate child restraint system based on age, size and weight.
- Children must not travel in front seat unless airbag is deactivated.
- Use ISOFIX and Top Tether if available.
- Do not leave children unattended in the vehicle.
- Rearward-facing child seats must not be used with active front passenger airbag.
In case of emergency: - Stop the vehicle safely and activate hazard lights.
- Apply parking brake and switch off ignition.
- Exit the vehicle safely and place warning triangle.
- Follow local legal requirements in emergency situations.
- Seek professional help or roadside assistance if needed.
